## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Both complete (921 / 486 pts, no interrupt, leakage < trip throughout). Raw first, then the 1/B read. Channel arithmetic: R = sr1_X / |I_drain|, I_drain = sr0_X / (−10⁶) ≈ 9.9 nA — the measured drain current, not the nominal bias. F_L = (h/4e)·n: **33.1 T** (run 6), **12.4 T** (run 7). The onset/FFT read uses the fine 10 mT segment (B ≥ 1 T) on run 6 — the 50 mT segment below 1 T undersamples a 7 T tone below B ≈ 0.85 T (Δ(1/B) Nyquist), so sub-1 T tracking on run 6 is grid-limited, not physics.

# Runs 6-7 raw: Rxx(B) and drain current, gain-divided, no background removal
runs67 = {}
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7), sharex='col')
for i, (rid, nlab) in enumerate(((6, '+3.2e12 (electron)'), (7, '-1.2e12 (hole)'))):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col('magnet_field'); o = np.argsort(B); B = B[o]
    I = r.col('sr0_X')[o] / (-1e6)          # drain current, A (Ithaco -1e6 V/A)
    R = r.col('sr1_X')[o] / np.abs(I)       # Rxx, ohm (sr1 gain 1)
    runs67[rid] = (B, R, I)
    print(summarize_run(r))
    print(f'run {rid}: I_drain median {np.median(np.abs(I))*1e9:.2f} nA; '
          f'R(B_lo) {R[:5].mean():.0f} ohm, R(B_hi) {R[-5:].mean():.0f} ohm, Rmax {R.max():.0f} ohm '
          f'({R.max()/5.05e3*100:.0f}% of 5 kOhm FS - no clip)')
    axs[0, i].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    axs[0, i].set_ylabel('Rxx (ohm)'); axs[0, i].set_title(f'run {rid}: n = {nlab}, D = 0, T = 1.2-1.3 K')
    axs[1, i].plot(B, np.abs(I)*1e9, lw=0.6, color='tab:orange')
    axs[1, i].set_ylabel('|I_drain| (nA)'); axs[1, i].set_xlabel('B (T)')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# Runs 6-7: onset + FFT-in-1/B read vs F_L and the FS-count forward model
import sys
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count')
import fs_count_b0 as fscm

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 7))
for row, (rid, nn) in enumerate(((6, +3.2e12), (7, -1.2e12))):
    B, R, I = runs67[rid]
    m = B >= 1.0                       # fine-grid segment only (run 7 is 20 mT throughout; keep symmetric)
    FL = luttinger_frequency(nn * 1e4)  # n in m^-2
    print(f'===== run {rid}: n = {nn:+.1e} cm^-2, F_L = {FL:.1f} T =====')
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R[m], B[m], r_full_scale=5e-5 / np.median(np.abs(I)))
        print(on.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print('SdhOnsetError:', e)

    # bg-subtracted trace in 1/B
    p = np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5)
    axs[row, 0].plot(1/B[m], R[m] - np.polyval(p, B[m]), lw=0.6)
    axs[row, 0].set_xlabel('1/B (1/T)'); axs[row, 0].set_ylabel('dRxx (ohm)')
    axs[row, 0].set_title(f'run {rid}: bg-subtracted (deg-5 in B), B >= 1 T')

    # FFT, two windows: full record vs pre-QH (stability check)
    ax = axs[row, 1]
    for (lo, hi), style in (((1.0, 10.0), '-'), ((1.0, 7.4), '--')):
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[m][:, None], B[m], b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5)
        s = spec[0]
        ax.plot(freqs, s / s.max(), style, lw=0.9, label=f'B in [{lo}, {hi}] T')
        ip, _ = find_peaks(s, height=0.03 * s.max(), prominence=0.02 * s.max())
        top = sorted(zip(s[ip], freqs[ip]), reverse=True)[:8]
        print(f'  FFT [{lo},{hi}]: ' + ', '.join(f'{f:.1f} T ({a/s.max():.2f})' for a, f in top))
    ax.axvline(FL, color='k', ls=':', lw=1, label=f'F_L = {FL:.1f} T')
    # model tones at nominal density (scale = geometry prior, semi-quantitative)
    ef, orbs = fscm.abab_fs(nn * 1e4)
    for j, (F, kf) in enumerate(orbs):
        ax.axvline(F, color='tab:red', ls='--', lw=0.8,
                   label='ABAB model tones' if j == 0 else None)
    print(f'  model @ nominal n: ABAB pair {[f"{F:.1f}" for F, _ in orbs]} T, ABCA singleton {FL:.1f} T')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 70); ax.set_xlabel('F (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('FFT (norm.)')
    ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.set_title(f'run {rid}: FFT in 1/B')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6–7).** **Electron side (run 6, F_L = 33.1 T) is the fan side** — deep, clean oscillations from B ≈ 1.4 T. Tone set: **7.3 T** (strong, censored at the 1 T record edge — true onset unmeasured), **22.3 T**, and **29.4 T**, plus 14.8 T (≈ 2×7.3, harmonic-consistent) and high-B comb members (43.7/58.6 T) that appear only in the QH-dominated window B ≳ 5 T. Two readings survive at one density and the fan must separate them: (a) **ABAB-like pair** — light 7.3 + heavy 22.3, sum 29.6 ≈ F_L at a global density scale ≈ 0.89 (inside the lever-arm prior), with 29.4 the symmetry-allowed breakdown/sum tone; partition 0.25/0.75 vs model 0.28/0.72, and the model pair at nominal n is (7.3, 25.8) — light tone dead-on, heavy 14% low, consistent with one global rescale; or (b) 22.3 = **3rd harmonic of 7.3** (ratio 3.05 — exactly the confound zone the investigation flags) and 29.4 ≈ 4×7.3 — leaving a single-family comb, which would *not* close a Luttinger sum at F_L and points elsewhere. The discriminator is **n-dependence**: a harmonic tracks 3·f_light exactly; a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (model: light 2.0 → 7.3 T vs heavy 13.5 → 25.8 T over n = 1.5 → 3.2×10¹², trajectories strongly non-parallel). **Hole side (run 7, F_L = 12.4 T)** is the predicted near-CNP exception regime: crowded low-frequency set whose extraction is window-unstable (7.1/12.6/18.9 T on B ≥ 1 T vs 6.6/9.4/4.7 T on the full record — a fork to report, not refine), no clean template — consistent with the model's close, balanced ABAB hole pair, uninformative for the call. **Decision: Landau fan on the electron side at D = 0** (investigation Step 4); the fan also resolves the F_L-tone origin (29.4 T strengthening-with-B check works per-column with the B-window split). Run 6's onset is censored — the light tone is still at SNR ≈ 96 at the 1 T fine-segment edge — so a cheap low-field extension (0.3 → 1 T at 10 mT, ~15 min, riding the positioning ramp) pins B_lo before the fan commits.

## HERA — low-field onset extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check` Verify), before the fan commits its B_lo

> **05:29** · onset extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 electron spot, B 0.3->1.0 T, 10 mT, sr1 50 uV, same settling as run 6 · **ETA ~05:44** (≈15 min)

Run 6's carrying tone (7.3 T) is **censored at the fine-segment edge** (SNR ≈ 96 at B = 1 T; the 50 mT segment below 1 T undersamples it — Nyquist fails below ≈ 0.85 T), so the true onset is unmeasured and the fan's B_lo is unpinned. The recipe's prescription: a cheap low-field extension before committing a long fan. This leg re-measures B = 0.3 → 1.0 T at the same 10 mT grid, same spot (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, run-5 cal), same sensitivity/settling as run 6 — the two records stitch into one 0.3 → 10 T spot record. It rides the fan's positioning ramp: the magnet sits at 0 T, the leg ends at 1.0 T with gates at the fan's high-n corner — zero re-traverse. Decision rule for the fan: measured onset ≥ 0.55 T → fan B_lo = onset; still censored at 0.3 T → fan B_lo stays 1.0 T (a sub-1 T fan start doubles the row count for light-tone record we can price separately). Checkpoint: first rows via the armed watch (signal scale ~50–70 Ω, leakage < 1 nA, field tracking).

# === Low-field onset extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check` Verify): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.3 -> 1.0 T at 10 mT ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)  # run-5 calibration
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V (run-6 point)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: leg starts at 0.3), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.30, 1.0001, 0.01), 4)   # 71 pts, 10 mT — matches run 6's fine grid
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # unchanged from runs 6/7
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check low-field onset extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.0 T at 10 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension of run 6 (censored light tone): n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform-B 10 mT; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# ends at 1.0 T with gates at the spot — the fan (next cell) starts here; no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
